T^{-1}-stable since T = X_1/X_0 restricts from V_0, and V_0 \cap V_1 is the basic open of the pulled-back chart coordinate inside affine V_0, giving surjectivity up to powers. New P1-side inputs (Cohomology/FinitenessP1.lean): the scheme-level basic open of the chart coordinate t = X_j/X_i in Gamma(D_+(X_i)) is the chart overlap; the structure algebra map on D_+(f) is k -> (k[X_0,X_1]_f)_0 -> Gamma(D_+(f)); T, T^{-1} and scalars of the Laurent identification as restrictions from the charts. Derive the instance Module.Finite k H^1(C,O_C) for the challenge curve (consuming exists_isFinite_toP1), keyed on genus's letI spelling — genus is now the dimension of an honestly finite-dimensional space.
